partners.name: Koramangala 1th Block
partners.notes:
We believe fitness shouldn't be confined to four walls. Iconic Fitness was built to break the chains of the traditional gym membership — where you're locked into one location, one brand, one routine.

Our Mission — Give everyone the freedom to train wherever life takes them.

Our Vision — Build the largest, most accessible fitness network, powered by a single membership.

trainers.name: Rohan Iyer
trainers.bio: NSCA-CSCS coach with 8 years training pro athletes. Specialises in powerlifting and rehab.

trainers.name: Priya Sharma
trainers.bio: E-RYT 500 vinyasa and ashtanga teacher trained in Mysore. Calm, precise, demanding in the best way.

trainers.name: Vikram Singh
trainers.bio: CF-L3, regional competitor 2019. Builds programmes that scale from beginner to elite.

trainers.name: Ayesha Khan
trainers.bio: Former amateur boxer, now head coach at Combat Lab. Sharp pad work and brutal conditioning.

trainers.name: Karan Joshi
trainers.bio: Mobility-first coach. Combines kettlebells, gymnastics rings, and Z-Health drills.

trainers.name: Meera Nair
trainers.bio: Polestar-certified pilates instructor. Reformer specialist with a background in classical dance.

trainers.name: Aditya Verma
trainers.bio: Group fitness lead at Move Studio. Designs metcons that leave you laughing on the floor.

trainers.name: Sneha Reddy
trainers.bio: Hot yoga, prenatal, and meditation teacher with 12 years on the mat.

trainers.name: Rahul Kapoor
trainers.bio: Olympic weightlifting coach. Trains national-level juniors twice a week.

trainers.name: Tara Bose
trainers.bio: Indoor cycling instructor and certified spinning master. The playlist alone is worth the class.

trainers.name: Devansh Gupta
trainers.bio: Bodybuilding-focused coach. Has prepped clients for Mr. India Classic Physique.

trainers.name: Naina Pillai
trainers.bio: Reformer and barre instructor. Postpartum recovery specialist.

class_sessions.description: Pad work, bag rounds, and brutal finishers. All levels.

class_sessions.description: Compound lifts with coached cues and tempo work.

class_sessions.description: Long-held postures with breathwork. Recover and reset.

class_sessions.description: Boxing-style HIIT. Mitts, bag rounds, and core finisher.

class_sessions.description: Full body session — push, pull, hinge, squat.

class_sessions.description: Deep stretches held 3–5 minutes for connective tissue.

class_sessions.description: Coach-led open mat — grappling and striking drills.

class_sessions.description: 30-minute full-body HIIT. In and out, drenched.

class_sessions.description: Programmed strength session. Five-week block.
